description: AirLLM 2.8T LLM inference with single 4GB GPU
summary: AirLLM streams weights layer-by-layer (per-expert for MoE models, file-mapping the n-gram table on the host) so a 671B checkpoint fits in roughly 12 GB of VRAM on a single card, with no quantization or distillation step to reason about. That collapses the "I need a multi-GPU box to run a local scorer for Proreerfolio job-fit checks" problem into "it runs on the workstation next to my desk," which is the local-first, observable setup I actually want. The training path is the sleeper feature: frozen weights stay on disk, only adapters live on the GPU, so I can fine-tune a 125B MoE on a 3060 Ti and iterate on agent behavior in PenguPool without a cloud invoice.
